briefing.headline: Soft landing holds as jobs tighten and inflation edges down toward target.

quotable_numbers.sentence: Unemployment fell to 4.1 percent in Oct 2026, giving the expansion room to run.
Core CPI at 2.6 percent for Sep 2026 is nearing the Fed's target, letting rates stay steady.

briefing.whats_new: Today: Unemployment tighter, from 4.2 percent to 4.1 percent.
